snippet.title: Shopping Cart Hero 2 (Browser/Flash) - Gameplay | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Shopping Cart Hero 2 is the second sequel of the popular funny distance game. In this game you’ll take control of a stick man with a goal of flying high and reaching far with a shopping cart. The game features more tricks, more items, and more upgrades than the previous game. Shopping Cart Hero 2 also features better graphics and audio as well as a much smoother gameplay. Speed down the mountain slope and fly off the edge in this crazy skill game.

▌Browser & Flash/HTML5 Gameplays Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXEHhSievieGLNZRFyssXFWhppX_0vXHT
